minors.issue: The diff deletes the package doc comment ('// Package cli is the moonglass command line: ...'), and no other file in internal/cli has one, so the package now has no documentation.
minors.scenario: go doc moonglass.dev/moonglass/internal/cli shows no package description.

minors.issue: No test checks the emitted Inputs literal (Flag, JSON, Kind name, Required, Doc). The runner tests build commands through commands() via RunDeclared, and TestGeneratedCLIIsCurrent covers only servers.list, which has no inputs.
minors.scenario: If Generate wrote Required: %t from the wrong value or the wrong kindNames entry, every test would still pass, and the first operation with inputs (W2-11d) would ship a CLI whose flags differ from what the runner tests exercised.

minors.issue: The flag package also accepts the single-dash spelling of each flag (-project, -env, -health-path). The spec's 'no aliases' does not list that second spelling.
minors.scenario: moonglass test get -project p -env e is accepted and sent, while the spec documents only --project and --env.

minors.issue: Generate does not refuse two input fields that map to the same flag name (json 'environment' and json 'env' both become --env). The runner then registers the flag twice, and flag.FlagSet panics.
minors.scenario: An In with Environment string `json:"environment"` and Env string `json:"env"` generates cleanly, but every run of that subcommand panics with 'flag redefined: env' instead of make generate failing and naming the operation and field.
